title: QuestionsRequest
description: POST /next_question: what we know so far about the buyer, and which optional questions were already asked. Returns the next easy follow-up, or says it is time to show results.

needs.description: Needs fields known so far (any subset of contracts/needs.schema.json properties; each present field is checked against it).

asked.description: Optional fields the buyer was already asked about (answered or skipped). They are never asked again.
